servinfo.title: Maintenance Recommended under Severe Driving conditions
servinfo.ptxt: Follow this schedule if your vehicle is mainly operated under one or more of the following conditions:

item.ptxt: When most trips are less than 6 km (4 miles).
When most trips are less than 16 km (10 miles) and outside temperature remain below freezing.
Idling and/or low-speed operation in stop-and-go traffic.
Operating in extremely cold weather and/or on salted roads.
Operating in rough and/or muddy areas.
Repeated high speed drive or high engine revolutions.

servinfo.ptxt: Schedule should also be followed if the vehicle is used for delivery service, police, taxi or other commercial applications.

item.ptxt: The intervals should be determined based on odometer readings or months, whichever comes first.
The following table shows the service schedule up to 90,000 km (54,000 miles). Beyond 90,000 km (54,000 miles), perform the same maintenance services at the same intervals shown in the table.

entry.ptxt:
Engine oil and engine oil filter (R:
)
Replace every 10,000 km (6,000 miles) or 8 months.
Replace every 30,000 km (18,000 miles) or 24 months.

Brake hoses and pipes (fluid leakage, damage) (I:
)

Parking brake lever and cable (play, damage) (I:
)
Inspect every 30,000 km (18,000 miles) or 24 months.
Replace every 60,000 km (36,000 miles) or 48 months.

item.ptxt: “I”: Inspect, clean, adjust, lubricate or replace it if necessary
